source_visual_inspection.scope: Assistant inspected native sinograms, truth and three saved maps with common within-domain scales. This is a source inspection, not canonical visual acceptance.

findings: One 128x128 synthetic phantom with full (180x192) and short (116x192) count-independent projection arrays. Angles cover 360 and 232.891121 degrees with excluded endpoints and different steps; no physical millimeter or HU calibration. All seven numeric/metadata assets verified.

The executed source position is (-256*sin(beta),256*cos(beta)), a quarter turn from the README formula. Metadata and Parker use atan(det_pos/256)=26.445561 degrees at the outer bin, but physical source-detector separation is 512, giving 13.966007 degrees. Original geometry and weights are retained.

The projector is a pixel-driven two-bin splat with 512/U magnification. Three unit-pixel controls reproduce detector coordinates and weights. Fixture forward, backprojection and FBP errors are below 6e-14. Both saved FBP reconstructions match exactly after float32 conversion from source replay of saved noisy measurements.

A fixed Euclidean adjoint control gives <Ax,y>=154.940259 versus <x,By>=25.296716, relative discrepancy 0.836732. The helper documented as radius-0.005 ball projection returns (3,4) unchanged with norm 5. These qualify source algorithm descriptions; no iterative solver was executed or saved output invalidated.

The 150 saved loss samples are data fidelity without the TV penalty. 66 of 149 successive steps increase; first 1921043.5, last 62483.1914. No intermediate reconstruction images or monotone convergence claim.

Native scores use a 104x104 crop after removing 12 pixels per edge, covering 10816/16384 pixels, and independently normalize each crop. Saved native NCC/NRMSE are full FBP 0.6518/0.1929, short FBP 0.5578/0.2110, TV-labelled 0.9661/0.0855; all match retained notebook cell 17 to four decimals.

The notebook prints historical boundaries 0.8695 NCC and 0.0941 NRMSE, but the pinned source tree and asset manifest contain no metrics.json. Actual generic scores have no pass/fail status; those printed boundaries were not installed.

Actual generic scoring selects data/ground_truth.npz:phantom and evaluates the full unnormalized image. Saved generic NCC/NRMSE are 0.637988/0.185350, 0.562577/0.192722 and 0.970626/0.063428. Native NPZ alone fails filename checking; stacked maps and loss-only vectors fail shape checks; non-filesystem fallback errors on missing ground_truth.npy.

Half-strength truth, truth plus one, and outside-crop additions each preserve native NCC 1 / NRMSE 0. Generic NRMSE changes to 0.116547, 1 and 5.829612. Truth-copy scoring is perfect but establishes no reconstruction capability.
Actual L1-L3 local seeding copies the complete data directory including ground_truth.npz. No source/evaluation directory is seeded. All environment and package installation commands were intercepted.

The benchmark MIT notice, cited leehoy GPLv2 text and absent license file in the pinned xtie97 tree are separately recorded. The cited xtie97 implementation uses curved-detector ray tracing, unlike the benchmark flat-detector pixel splat; upstream equivalence is not claimed.
